issue.title: Record the due-occurrence RECURRING walk contract in decision and freshness memory
issue.description:
Proposed independently by bob-cli-5p.1 note #1, bob-cli-5p.2 note #2, bob-cli-5p.3 note #1, and bob-cli-5p.4 note #1. The approved epic DECISIONS explicitly select memory_records=no, prohibit memory edits, and require a memory task for the deferred changes. Audited reads on 2026-10-08 confirm decisions/review-walk-is-tiered.md still says recurring tasks are in no tier except PRE/POST; glossary/task-freshness.md still lists nine tiers. Rust schema 11 and ledger namespace v9 now add due-occurrence RECURRING between NEXT and TICKLER.

After explicit memory authorization, add decisions/recurring-occurrences-walk-when-due.md with the shared contract, selected tier_position=before_tickler and ctrl_alt_f=refuse, alternatives, costs, reopening criteria, and evidence from plan:202610/recurring_review_tier.md, Rust 56a5e68, ledger 9233b0c, and the eventual nav landing. Mark the older decisions/review-walk-is-tiered.md superseded-in-part with superseded_by and a back-link identifying the retired order, blanket recurring exclusion, and broad rejected alternative; preserve the immutable accepted body. Update glossary/task-freshness.md to ten tiers and explain that recurring occurrences are never stamped and resolve through completion, rescheduling past today, Today linkage, or cancellation through Tasks. Run sase memory init after approved edits. Do not infer permission from this task's ready state.

This is distinct from bob-cli-3y, which covers unrecorded PROJECTS hide gating and REFERENCES cadence/scope, not RECURRING; coordinate supersession of the shared older record with that worker. Size small: exact paths and intended wording are already specified in the approved epic's memory_records branch.

evidence.note: Approved plan: plan:202610/unify_reference_task_freshness.md (artifact file:explicit:021c6821d3325cddb7ab2511) also declines updating glossary/task-freshness.md, but lands a new current tier order with no REFERENCES tier and ordinary reference-task freshness. Coordinate this glossary edit with the recurring contract already tracked here; use the implemented order and keep the recurring-specific requirements that remain valid.

payload.description: Need to compare this open memory task with the skipped freshness-policy updates

evidence.note: Independent evidence from the daily-stats lead consolidation (2026-10-11): the walk has moved on again since this task was filed. bob-cli docs/freshness.md:461 (schema 13) and bob-ledger-tools FRESHNESS_TIER_ORDER (src/100-freshness-evaluate.js:680, bob-plugins 6a5178c) now use nine groups PRE → NEW → PROJECTS → PENDING → NEXT → RECURRING → TICKLER → ROTTEN → POST; schema 13 REMOVED the REFERENCES tier (references now walk through ordinary tiers). decisions:review-walk-is-tiered still lists REFERENCES and no RECURRING. So this task's 'ten tiers' glossary target is now wrong (should be nine), and bob-cli-3y's REFERENCES-tier proposal is obsolete. Impact: memory readers (e.g. stats/journal designs that key on tier names) get a wrong roster.
